description.value: Jade City is a world-famous jade mining destination on the Cassiar-Stewart Highway (Hwy-37) in the Cassiar Mountain Range, founded in 1985 and featured on Discovery Channel's Jade Fever. The motel offers 4 rooms with an open veranda, shared shower facilities, and a dining area, all set amid jade boulders and mining equipment with mountain views. It is one of very few accommodation options on this remote northern highway, making it a key stop for touring cyclists traversing the Cassiar corridor.

address.value: Box B8, Jade City, BC V0C 1E0

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content confirms Jade City Motel is a real, operating accommodation on Hwy-37 in the Cassiar Mountain Range of Northern BC, with active room listings and booking links. WIFI (24/7) and breakfast (eggs, bagels) are explicitly listed as included amenities for all accommodation types including the motel. No mention of bike storage, bike-specific facilities, laundry, or staff bike procedures appears anywhere on the site; those fields remain null.
